comment: The examples are useful for explaining the architecture, but they largely demonstrate the architecture through health-system/clinical goals. A more operational example could help bridge the gap between the reference model and implementation.

reviewer.name: Lakshmi Balachandran, Obaroene Ogidiagba, Boluwatito Adeyemi, Sameen Babur, Srikant Mohan, Lauren Theis

anchor.note: p.48-52 l.152-193 read as the PDF page; section 3.3 does NOT agree

public.text: The examples are useful for explaining the architecture, but they largely demonstrate the architecture through health-system/clinical goals. A more operational example could help bridge the gap between the reference model and implementation.
public.suggestedRevision: Consider adding one or more example based on an operational public health intervention, alongside the existing examples, to demonstrate how the architecture supports time-bound, population-level activities.
